unit:
✔ all seven rotate on successive London dates, consistently within a day (19.774458ms)
✔ scores maximise, Saw Duel minimises positive times, and stars merge per level (2.586792ms)
✔ sound defaults off, nickname starts blank, and nudges cap at two per week (1.35875ms)
✔ real SQL concurrent saves keep best, preserve health/pile/food and separate accounts without requiring health consent (30.851166ms)
✔ arcade export contains only owner; account erasure clears arcade atomically, health erasure keeps it (4.398417ms)
✔ actual SQL CAS awards once across twenty overlapping saves, a second session, refresh and retries (42.39175ms)
✔ Done cannot write actual-food totals; feedback stays optional and changes a future offer with a reason (4.088208ms)
✔ 30th milestone is one durable database award across devices; privacy preference needs no new tracking consent (11.47825ms)
✔ account ownership, Origin, paused tracking and a consent withdrawal at the SQL write fail closed (4.70175ms)
✔ initial preparation preserves existing logs, milestone, words and unrelated settings (23.37025ms)
✔ withdrawn tracking cannot initialise or overwrite member records (0.857625ms)
✔ crew ACLs come from authenticated membership and disclose only opted-in effort (41.155333ms)
✔ joining requires deliberate consent, an unexpired invitation and space (6.911542ms)
✔ Monday reads the new weekly score without resetting lifetime pile (2.048708ms)
✔ food writes use server source values, ignore supplied macros and do not alter the pile (36.235208ms)
✔ overlapping food retries insert once and rebuild totals atomically (13.388209ms)
✔ portion edits keep source and preserve pile; stale edits cannot replace a newer record (6.552417ms)
✔ search does no external lookup, account mismatch and missing consent fail closed (4.456416ms)
✔ one log per London calendar day survives swaps, retries, reloads and another device (25.247375ms)
✔ Done saves only the action; food totals have no write path (0.199958ms)
✔ optional feedback and dismissal keep the log; negative feedback explains tomorrow’s change (0.679542ms)
✔ weight defaults on, off chooses strength, and re-enabling leads with weight (0.945083ms)
✔ a hard week never clears the pile, and Monday resets only the derived weekly count (0.300708ms)
✔ 30th milestone is awarded once, preserved across retries; sharing cannot expose private fields (4.277958ms)
✔ London midnight and daylight-saving boundaries use the existing account calendar (0.313333ms)
✔ ten original actions have three swaps within 5g using unrounded source data (0.991583ms)
✔ different database versions, missing values and unverified recipes cannot pass as matched swaps (0.232458ms)
✔ own saved plan targets are used, and absent or zero targets stay unknown (1.01475ms)
✔ UK FoP exact boundaries, food/drink differences and large-portion overrides (0.130834ms)
✔ portions preserve source, leave missing nutrients unknown, and actual-eaten totals ignore planned meals (0.251625ms)
✔ preparation stops once the ranked original has three safe sourced alternatives (21.841709ms)
✔ nightly observations retain recorded dates and never infer why weight changed (14.592959ms)
✔ overnight job prepares once, does not change the pile, and never runs from a screen GET (2.582625ms)
✔ hidden weight is suppressed when reading an older prepared insight (0.556542ms)
✔ existing health erasure transaction also clears only the requesting account V7 stores (2.19725ms)
✔ a failed original erasure rolls back V7 additions in the same transaction (0.883083ms)
✔ public frame streams before identity completes; private data waits for verified account (28.767833ms)
✔ signed-out stream contains no private snapshot and does not masquerade as a member (2.584625ms)
✔ hidden-weight presentation removes body weight, changes, BMI, stalls and device weights across nested views (0.797042ms)
✔ nutrition targets and a strength activity measured in kg are retained (0.111333ms)
✔ explicit tracking grant stays signed in; withdrawal still clears all open private views (16.012917ms)
✔ logout, deletion and unknown successful consent mutations retain fail-closed purge (3.037792ms)
